classification.difficultyReason: Read marked integers directly from labelled number lines.

content.prompt: Read values from a number line

spec.description: Horizontal black number line approximately 78 mm wide and 12 mm high, with arrowheads at both ends. Eleven equally spaced black ticks labelled below in serif mathematical numerals. A filled blue circular dot is centred on the tick labelled 3. No axis name.
spec.mathematics: Ticks and labels at every integer from -5 through 5, increasing left to right, including 0. Arrowheads extend slightly past the end ticks. Closed blue dot (#3399ff) at 3.
